newsitem.title: UK: UK drought not over, despite rain, agency says.
newsitem.headline: UK drought not over, despite rain, agency says.

text.p: Britain's drought has not ended, despite the wettest June this century, according to the Environment Agency.
Although June's rainfall has been useful in cutting the need for irrigation and watering of gardens, the rainfall is not reaching aquifers, where levels remain low, the agency said, in a statement.
Environment agency records for the Anglia region show that 125 millimetres of rain fell in June, compared with a long term average of 51 millimetres.
But around 40 per cent of the population in the region are reliant on groundwater supplies, which still stand at the lowest on record in many areas, the agency said.
